name: robo-journey
description: A hardware-accurate Arduino circuit simulator — real firmware execution on an emulated ATmega328P, coupled to a real analog circuit solver.

scripts.build: tsc --build packages/sim-core packages/compile-service packages/parts packages/datasheet packages/accounts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc -p packages/sim-core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/compile-service/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/parts/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/datasheet/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/accounts/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run settle && npm run bench
